tool.name: SailPoint Agent Identity Security
tool.description: Discovers and governs AI agents in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud with human owners, access reviews and revocation.
strengths: Aggregates AWS, Azure, GCP, Salesforce agents
tool.practitionerNote: Governance-first: good for ownership and access certification of agents alongside human identities, not for runtime token issuance or MCP enforcement.

soc2.detail: SailPoint completes an annual SOC 2 Type 2 audit of Identity Security Cloud.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary SailPoint product; agent ownership and certifications live in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
